FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

What is LLM SEO? +
LLM SEO is the practice of structuring your content so large language models can understand, trust, and reference your brand inside AI-generated answers. It focuses on authority, clarity, entity consistency, and answer-ready content rather than only traditional ranking signals.
How is LLM SEO different from traditional SEO? +
Traditional SEO focuses on ranking pages in search engines. LLM SEO focuses on making your brand authoritative enough to be included inside AI-generated responses from systems like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews. The strongest strategy uses both together.
How to get cited in AI answers? +
Clear service explanations, strong topical depth, crawlable internal links, structured formatting, consistent brand signals, experience-backed insights, and proof of expertise improve your chances of citation. Citation comes from trust and relevance, not from stuffing keywords.
Can LLM SEO work together with AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO? +
Yes. LLM SEO works best when paired with traditional SEO, AEO, and GEO. Traditional SEO strengthens rankings, AEO improves direct-answer visibility, GEO improves generative search visibility, and LLM SEO helps your brand become more reference-worthy across AI systems.
Does LLM SEO improve ROI? +
Yes. Higher AI visibility improves trust, supports better-quality inbound traffic, reduces long-term dependency on paid acquisition, and increases the chance that your brand is shortlisted before a user even clicks through to your website.
